summary: The S&P 500 slipped 0.25% today to 7,711.76, with tech stocks leading the drop after Fed Chair Kevin Warsh signaled at Jackson Hole that interest rates may need to rise further to bring inflation down. That pushed the 10 year Treasury yield, which is the interest rate the US government pays to borrow for a decade, up to 4.72%. Gold fell 1.73% while bitcoin rose 1.19%. The big week ahead includes Friday's jobs report, which will either confirm or challenge Warsh's inflation concern.
